description: This Java class 'LoginPage' models the login page of the OrangeHRM application using the Page Object Model pattern. It encapsulates interactions such as entering username and password, clicking login, and verifying page states or error messages, for use in automated Selenium tests.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Represents the login page of OrangeHRM in the Page Object Model, providing methods to interact with login form elements and verify login page states.

methods.name: LoginPage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the WebDriver and WebDriverWait for the page object.

methods.name: enterUsername
methods.description: Inputs the specified username into the username field.

methods.name: enterPassword
methods.description: Inputs the specified password into the password field.

methods.name: clickLoginButton
methods.description: Clicks the login button to attempt login.

methods.name: isDashboardPageDisplayed
methods.description: Checks if the dashboard page is currently displayed based on URL content.

methods.name: isDashboardHeaderVisible
methods.description: Determines if the dashboard page header is visible.

methods.name: isErrorMessageDisplayed
methods.description: Verifies if the specified error message is visible on the page.

methods.name: isUrlContaining
methods.description: Checks if the current URL contains a specified fragment.

methods.name: isRequiredFieldMessageDisplayed
methods.description: Checks if validation messages for required fields are displayed.
